message:
As we consider the importance of preparedness, it can be helpful to think of it as an opportunity to gather our loved ones and create a cozy little project together. 🤗 Assembling an emergency kit can be a fun and informative activity, where we share our thoughts on what essentials might be most useful. 

From snacks to first-aid supplies, each item tells a story of care and readiness. Let’s make it a time to connect, reflect, and set our minds at ease knowing we’re taking steps to be prepared. After all, who doesn’t love a little teamwork and creativity? What would you add to your cozy kit?
